news.headline: Crude Oil -1.2% (WTI $101.6, Brent $110.4)
news.what_happened: WTI and Brent both slipped about 1.2% overnight but remain at very elevated levels.
news.why_it_matters: Falling crude eases input costs for airlines and paint makers; OMC and upstream oil see margin/realization pressure.

news.headline: US 10Y yield rises to 5.05% (+1%)
news.what_happened: US 10-year yield climbed to 5.045% while S&P 500 (+0.28%) and Nasdaq (+0.27%) closed modestly higher.
news.why_it_matters: Rising US yields are a headwind for EM flows and rate-sensitive Indian sectors despite a mildly positive US equity cue.

news.headline: Asia mixed; Nifty closed -0.24% at 22,699
news.what_happened: Hang Seng -0.15%, Nikkei +0.07%; Nifty 50 ended the previous session at 22,698.85. Rupee flat at 95.21.
news.why_it_matters: Flat rupee gives no FX trigger for IT/pharma; Thursday is weekly expiry so open may be volatile.

sector_outlook.reason: US 10Y yield rising offsets mild US gains

picks.logic: Jet fuel is a major share of IndiGo's operating cost, so a lower crude price is a direct margin tailwind even at elevated levels.
Crude derivatives are a large share of paint raw material cost; easing crude supports gross margin outlook.
